svg.title: Side by side: Example Platform (fictional) and Example Platform (fictional)
svg.desc: 2 platforms aligned by band: the 6 layers and the 3 bands as columns, one platform per row.

g.aria-label: Sources: Where does the data come from?
Ingestion: How does data get into the platform?
Storage: Where is it kept, and in what format?
Processing and transformation: What engine cleans, joins and prepares it?
Consumption: How does it reach dashboards, reports and apps?
Artificial intelligence: How are models and agents built on the data?
Governance and security: Who can see what, and how is it audited?
Operations and cost: How is it monitored, deployed and paid for?
Orchestration: Who decides what runs, and when?
Example Platform (fictional): v0.1.0 · verified 6 days ago
Source systems: 1 component. Components: Admissions system.
Data intake: 2 components. Components: JDBC connector, Change capture.
Central store: 2 components. Components: Raw data zone, Clean tables in an open format.
Preparation: 3 components. Components: Transformation engine, Declarative pipelines, Interactive notebooks. removed.
Dashboards: 2 components. Components: Semantic model, Bed occupancy dashboard.
Agents: 1 component, public preview. Components: Data question agent.
Governance: 2 components. Components: Central catalog, Row filters and masking.
Usage monitor: 1 component. Components: Usage monitor.
Task scheduler: 1 component. Components: Task scheduler.
